name: earthwaltz
description: An interactive application that uses radar remote sensing data from the NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar (NISAR) mission to track and visualize one or more types of surface change at locations around the world.
si_acknowledgment: Code architecture, TypeScript UI components, and Python DEM/SAR data-processing pipelines were developed with the assistance of Super Intelligence (SI) coding tools under human scientific and engineering direction. No NASA logos or branding elements were generated or modified.
